title: Give the Entra Policy Suite engine a missing permission, or take one away
purpose: Grants the engine identity (id-eps-engine) the Microsoft Graph application permissions and the Exchange right Entra Policy Suite declares for it, when one is missing after the install - or takes one away with -Remove. Only the declared permissions can be asked for. Every change is read back.
whenToRun: When the permission check shows a missing right (the install ran as an account that could not grant it, or an approver granted it later), when a feature that needs a right is switched on, or with -Remove when a feature no longer needs it.

runAs.name: Privileged Role Administrator (or Global Administrator)
runAs.why: grants application permissions and the Exchange Recipient Administrator role to a managed identity

runAs.name: Reader
runAs.scope: the Entra Policy Suite resource group

changes.object: app role assignments on the engine identity
changes.permission: the Graph permissions asked for (from the declared list); Exchange.ManageAsApp with -Exchange
changes.why: the engine's features read and tag users and devices, read Conditional Access and the sign-in logs, move an adopted Conditional Access policy to the stage a SuperAdmin approved, and read Exchange recipients for the recipient conditions
changes.undo: run again with -Remove and the same permissions

changes.object: directory role assignment Exchange Recipient Administrator (with -Exchange)
changes.why: the recipient conditions read Exchange recipients

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: the install's resource group (an install made before 2.0.55: rg-entrapolicysuite, found by itself when it is there)

parameters.name: GraphPermission
parameters.help: the Graph permissions to grant or remove; none given: every Graph permission the engine needs

parameters.name: Exchange
parameters.help: the Exchange right of the recipient conditions (Exchange.ManageAsApp + Exchange Recipient Administrator)

parameters.name: Remove
parameters.help: take the named rights away instead (it never removes everything at once)

readsOnly: Azure: the engine identity's object id
Graph: the engine identity's app role and directory role assignments
whatIf: What the engine has, and what would be granted or removed; nothing is changed.
undo: Run again with -Remove (or without it, to grant back).
